message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
If you’re looking at a different size or variety, the calorie count will vary slightly—small cherry tomatoes are around 5–7 calories each, while larger beefsteak tomatoes can reach 30–35 calories.
